title: NASA-UAP-D021, Gemini 7 Technical Debriefing, 1965
doc_notes: This document is a preliminary transcript of the Gemini 7 flight crew debriefing conducted in December 1965, containing technical mission details and crew observations. / This document is a transcript of the Gemini 7 flight crew debriefing conducted in December 1965, covering various operational, experimental, and observational topics.

incidents.summary: Gemini 7 crew observed a satellite passing underneath them while in orbit.
incidents.quote: at 16,40 we sighted a satellite much lower and on a slightly higher inclination path than we were.

incidents.summary: Astronauts observed a Minuteman reentry vehicle which appeared as a brilliant object that broke up into several pieces.
incidents.quote: It looked like a meteorite. Very brilliant. It broke up toward the end.

incidents.summary: Astronauts observed two satellites in polar orbits, one above and one below the spacecraft, crossing from left to right.
incidents.quote: It was a definite satellite in a polar orbit.
